connect.title: Pyniasoh ia LinkedIn
connect.intro: Sign in da ka LinkedIn account kaba pynïaid ïa ki ads jong phi. Leadrat ka pule tang ia ki jingkhein jong ki jingpynbna jong phi, ki jingpynbna Lead Gen Form bad ki jingkhein jingdiah jong ka jingpynbna, bad ka phah ia ki jingkylla kiba phi pynkylla.

connect.need2: Ka bynta ha ka sla jong ka kompeni ba la pyniasoh (U nongpyniaid, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , u nongpeit ne u nongpeit bniah) - LinkedIn ka dawa ia ka ban iasam ia ki nongialam.
connect.need3: Ka jingkylli shaphang u nombar phone ha Lead Gen Forms jong phi - ki nongïalam khlem u nombar phone kim lah ban pynrung.
